Returns & exchanges

Exchange window

Please contact us within 7 days of delivery to ask about an exchange. Pieces should be unworn and unwashed, with tags attached. Sale pieces may be exchanged for a different size only.

Received something damaged or incorrect?

Contact customer care as soon as possible and include your order details and a clear description of the issue.

How to request help

Get in touch before sending anything back. We will confirm the available options and return instructions. Please do not post an item without speaking to us first.
